title: Swap the arguments
description: Swap the two arguments in the signature and in every call.
start:
def area(width, height):
    return width * height

print(area(3, 4))
print(area(10, 2))
print(area(7, 5))
target:
def area(height, width):
    return width * height

print(area(4, 3))
print(area(2, 10))
print(area(5, 7))
